57.title: Orders of exactly €50 still pay shipping
57.body:
The banner says "Free shipping from €50", but an order whose subtotal is exactly €50.00 is charged €4.90 shipping.

Steps:
1. Add items worth €50.00 to the cart (e.g. two Canvas Tote at €25.00).
2. Go to checkout.

Actual: shipping €4.90, total €54.90.
Expected: shipping €0.00, total €50.00.

The quote endpoint the mobile app uses shows the same €4.90.

comments.author: desk-lead
comments.body: Confirmed, support has had three tickets about this this week.

merged_titles: feat(quote-api): return shipping in price quotes
fix(checkout): round line totals half up
refactor(shipping): extract the flat rate into a constant
